name: smwmusic-sonic-robo-blast-2-v2-2-wild-wild-dash-arid-canyon-zone-act
title: Sonic Robo Blast 2 (V2.2) - Wild Wild Dash ~ Arid Canyon Zone Act 1 (Remix)
description:
𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐲! 𝐓𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐥 𝐚𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐥 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐮𝐩 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡. 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐓𝐍𝐓 𝐛𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐬, 𝐒𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐜!

Did an arrangement of Arid Canyon Zone Act 1 from Sonic Robo Blast 2 (V2.2). Was replaying Sonic Robo Blast 2 a lot recently (especially with the Adventure Sonic mod out and it being as amazing as it is) and thought it'd be really nice to arrange a track from one of my favorite stages in this awesome DOOM mod. Seriously, Arid Canyon Zone Act 1 is just... a damn freaking awesome Wild Western theme.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch [WARNING: If used, sound effects will be detuned as well. I highly recommend not using this in-game])
2. F Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
3. G Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
4. E Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
